product.title: Janssen -Face guard advanced 50ml
product.description:
About:
Light protection concentrate with SPF 30 and IR protection against premature light-induced skin ageing. Suitable for all skin types.
Similar to UV rays, infrared rays cause premature skin ageing and can lead to skin damage later on. It is therefore important not only to ensure adequate protection against UVA and UVB rays, but also to have an effective IR protection. FACE GUARD ADVANCED is a light emulsion with the cell protection active ingredient Ectoin®, which has been proven to protect the skin against environmental influences such as dryness, heat, cold and UV rays. A biotechnologically obtained enzyme also neutralizes free radicals and is considered an effective IR protection. FACE GUARD ADVANCED is therefore the ideal complementary care solution for every skin type all year round and can be easily combined with any day care product.

How to use:
FACE GUARD ADVANCED is spread over the skin in the morning after cleansing before the usual day care is applied.

Tip: FACE GUARD ADVANCED acts like an invisible glove to prevent pigmentation and age spots. Simply apply the light emulsion to the back of the hand and massage in lightly. Repeat several times a day.

Ingredients:
• Ultrafine titanium dioxide: An inorganic broad-spectrum filter that absorbs both UVA and UVB rays; due to their small size, its tiny particles are not visible on the skin

• Ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate: An organic UVB filter

istribute Melafadin Fluid gently over the cleansed skin. To do this, break off the top of the ampoule, using a paper tissue as protection, and pour the entire content into the palm of your hand. product.title: Bene Rose Tint – Long-Lasting Liquid Blush & Lip Tint
product.description:
Add a pop of natural, rosy color to your cheeks and lips with the Bene Rose Tint. This lightweight, liquid formula provides a sheer, buildable tint that blends seamlessly into your skin for a youthful, fresh glow. Whether you're looking for a subtle flush or a bold, defined look, this versatile makeup product is designed to give you a natural, long-lasting finish that stays put throughout the day.

Key Features:

  • Natural Flush of Color: The Bene Rose Tint delivers a delicate, rosy hue that mimics the natural flush of your skin, creating a fresh and youthful appearance.
  • Long-Lasting Wear: Designed to stay in place all day without fading, making it perfect for busy days or evening events.
  • Buildable Formula: Achieve your desired intensity with a few drops, perfect for creating both subtle and bold looks.
  • Multi-Use Product: Use it as a cheek tint, lip tint, or even as an eyeshadow for a monochromatic makeup look.
  • Lightweight & Non-Greasy: The formula is lightweight and dries quickly without leaving any greasy residue, making it ideal for all skin types, including oily and sensitive skin.
  • Suitable for All Skin Tones: The universally flattering rose tint works beautifully on all skin tones, enhancing your natural beauty.

How to Use:

  1. For Cheeks: Apply a small amount of Bene Rose Tint to your fingertip and gently blend into the apples of your cheeks for a soft, rosy glow. Layer for more intensity.
  2. For Lips: Dab a few drops onto your lips and blend for a natural, tint finish. Add more for a deeper, more intense color.
  3. For Eyes: A few dots on the eyelids will create a fresh, monochromatic makeup look. Blend well for a smooth, even finish.
  4. Tip: Set with a light dusting of translucent powder for extra longevity if needed.

Why Choose Bene Rose Tint?

The Bene Rose Tint is more than just a cheek tint—it's your go-to all-in-one beauty product for effortless, radiant makeup. Whether you're looking to brighten up your everyday look or create a vibrant evening look, the Bene Rose Tint offers versatile use in a convenient, travel-friendly bottle. Its long-lasting, water-based formula ensures that your makeup stays fresh, vibrant, and comfortable all day.

Ideal For:

  • Anyone seeking a natural, buildable blush and lip tint.
  • All skin types, including oily and sensitive skin.
  • People looking for a multi-use makeup product for quick, versatile looks.
  • Busy individuals who need long-lasting makeup without the need for frequent touch-ups.

Ingredients:

Formulated with skin-loving ingredients that provide hydration and comfort, the Bene Rose Tint is free from harsh chemicals and suitable for all skin types. The formula is cruelty-free and dermatologically tested to ensure safety.
